Name: East Scarp Anime Portraits Replacer
Author: bunzbunzMODS
Description:
[size=3]Hello everyone! I created these anime portraits for the East Scarp MOD and the custom NPC expansion, Always Raining In The Valley. None of the characters belong to me. Original character credits are made by LemurKat, Kdau, and HimeTarts. I'm aware that the Always Raining In The Valley MOD is not up to date, but I wanted to create portraits for them anyways. The portraits still work regardless of how old the MOD is. These portraits are also meant to be paired with my other Anime portraits mods, since I also made them for some Stardew Valley Expanded characters. While these portraits are not complete for every character, I will continue to update them once I get them done. It may take some time - I'm focusing more on my personal projects. Hopefully that's understandable. Anyways, Thank you for choosing my portraits! I really do appreciate the support.[/size]

[size=3] ﻿- bunzbunz <3[/size]

[b][size=4]NOTE!![/size][/b]
[size=3] just like my other mods, these are portrait REPLACERS and are not a functioning mod on its own. You'll need to unzip the .PNG of each character's portraits and replace the already existing ones in the East Scarp MOD folder and the Always Raining In The Valley MOD folder.[/size]
